canon.name: Hacker House Halloween
canon.frame: a first person view walking through a wild Halloween party in a San Francisco Victorian hacker house at night, filmed at eye height by a steady handheld camera with a natural lens, each space seen in depth, packed with guests in elaborate tech costumes under purple and orange party lights
canon.still: The camera stands still at eye height in the middle of the space for the whole clip while party lights pulse purple and orange, guests in costumes dance and laugh in the background and thin fog drifts low
canon.approach: In the first half second, the camera swings toward {thing} and leans in
canon.arrive: the doors burst open in a blast of purple light and fog and the camera rushes through into {thing}
canon.settle: In the last second, the camera steps back and comes to rest at eye height in the middle of the space, a clear steady view of everything in it while the party lights keep pulsing
canon.ambient: A thumping house music bassline, a crowd laughing and talking over each other, and foghorns sighing far off across the bay
canon.selectSound: A burst of party noise swells as the camera moves in
canon.lettering: clean slim startup sans in sentence case, glowing white like a lit sign
canon.style: glossy cinematic night film, purple and orange neon

ladder.mood: a fun packed San Francisco Halloween party where every guest wants to pitch the newcomer
the pitches get physical and the costumes start coming alive
ladder.ambient: Guests in the background hold their phones high, filming everything
ladder.sound: A confetti cannon booms and the crowd whoops

ladder.mood: the whole house starts raising money and every object is a startup
ladder.ambient: Glowing paper term sheets flutter through the air like bats
ladder.sound: A crowd chants the words seed round over and over

ladder.mood: the party reaches AGI and the house itself comes alive
ladder.ambient: Every string light and pumpkin in view pulses in sync with the bass
ladder.sound: A huge synth drop shakes the whole house

ladder.mood: the party crowns the visitor the founder of the year as the house lifts off over the fog
ladder.ambient: Guests in costumes cheer in a wide ring around the camera under falling confetti
ladder.sound: The whole party roars and a choir of robotaxi horns plays a fanfare
